distance.note: metres; f32 on integer differences is under 3e-7 of the distance up to 50 degrees of latitude, 6e-7 at 70; the cases reach 5 km

zone.note: 1e-7 degree units; the Rust centre is the integer mean, at most half a unit off, so a one-unit slip fails

zone_aspect.note: the long/short ratio; f32 sides hold it to ~3e-7
